## Join Superman Movies with Actor Data {.unnumbered}


### Description

Combines the superman_movies dataset with physical characteristics and
ratings data from the superman dataset, matched by actor name.



### Usage

<pre><code class='language-R'>join_superman_data(
  movies = NULL,
  actors = NULL,
  suffix = c("_movie", "_actor")
)
</code></pre>


### Arguments

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td style = "white-space: collapse; font-family: monospace; vertical-align: top"><code id="movies">movies</code></td>
<td>
A data frame of Superman movies (default: superman_movies)
</td></tr>
<tr><td style = "white-space: collapse; font-family: monospace; vertical-align: top"><code id="actors">actors</code></td>
<td>
A data frame of Superman actor data (default: superman)
</td></tr>
<tr><td style = "white-space: collapse; font-family: monospace; vertical-align: top"><code id="suffix">suffix</code></td>
<td>
Suffixes for disambiguating duplicate column names.
Default c(&quot;_movie&quot;, &quot;_actor&quot;).
</td></tr>
</table>


### Value

A tibble with movie data joined to actor data.



### Examples
```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
library("psych350data")

combined <- join_superman_data()
combined |> export_sav(path = "superman_combined.sav")



```
